reproducibility.final_probe_source:
import collections, copy, datetime, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from unittest.mock import patch
from tools import devprep

ROOT = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
assert ROOT == pathlib.Path(r'D:\Github\AETP\.prep-007-review-codex-20260908').resolve()
assert devprep.ROOT == ROOT
AUDIT = ROOT / '_audit'
START = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
paths = {name: ROOT / 'Docs/development' / (name + '.json') for name in ('backlog', 'knowledge-graph', 'status')}
original = {name: path.read_bytes() for name, path in paths.items()}
baseline = {name: json.loads(data.decode('utf-8-sig')) for name, data in original.items()}
reports = [devprep.DEVPREP_CHECK_PATH, devprep.GRAPH_CHECK_PATH, devprep.BACKLOG_CHECK_PATH, devprep.REPORT_PATH]
commands, scenarios = [], []


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()


def restore():
    for name, data in original.items():
        paths[name].write_bytes(data)


def material(name, data):
    paths[name].write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')


def report_facts():
    return {p.name: {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'mtime_ns': p.stat().st_mtime_ns} for p in reports}


def run_cli(label, subcommand, expected_exit):
    start = now()
    argv = [sys.executable, '-B', 'tools/devprep.py', subcommand]
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=30)
    commands.append(dict(id=label, argv=argv, cwd=str(ROOT), started_at=start, finished_at=now(), exit_code=result.returncode, expected_exit_code=expected_exit, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr))
    return result


def add(label, expected, ok, **observed):
    scenarios.append(dict(id=label, expected=expected, result='pass' if ok else 'fail', observed=observed))


def reject(label, mutate, subcommand='check', diagnostic=None):
    restore()
    data = copy.deepcopy(baseline)
    mutate(data)
    for name, document in data.items():
        material(name, document)
    before = report_facts()
    result = run_cli(label, subcommand, 1)
    unchanged = before == report_facts()
    ok = result.returncode == 1 and unchanged and 'ERROR ' in result.stdout and 'Traceback' not in result.stderr
    if diagnostic:
        ok = ok and diagnostic in result.stdout
    add(label, 'exit 1 with diagnostic, no replacement of existing success reports', ok, success_reports_unchanged=unchanged, diagnostic=result.stdout.strip(), exit_code=result.returncode)
    restore()


def sync_status(data):
    items = data['backlog']['work_items']
    states = ('todo','ready','in_progress','review','done','blocked')
    counts = {state: sum(item['status'] == state for item in items) for state in states}
    milestones = {}
    for milestone in ('PREP','M0','M1','M2','M3'):
        group = [item for item in items if item['milestone'] == milestone]
        c = {state: sum(item['status'] == state for item in group) for state in states}
        status = 'done' if group and c['done'] == len(group) else 'in_progress' if c['in_progress'] or c['review'] else 'blocked' if c['blocked'] else 'todo'
        milestones[milestone] = dict(status=status, total=len(group), **c)
    data['status']['work_item_status_counts'] = counts
    data['status']['milestones'] = milestones
    data['status']['active_work_items'] = sorted(item['id'] for item in items if item['status'] == 'in_progress')
    return counts, milestones


try:
    for name in paths:
        restore()
        paths[name].write_text('{"unfinished":', encoding='utf-8')
        before = report_facts()
        result = run_cli('invalid-json-' + name, 'check', 1)
        unchanged = before == report_facts()
        add('invalid-json-' + name, 'malformed JSON rejected without success-report writes', result.returncode == 1 and unchanged and 'cannot parse' in result.stdout, exit_code=result.returncode, success_reports_unchanged=unchanged, diagnostic=result.stdout.strip())
    reject('json-root-array', lambda d: d.__setitem__('backlog', []), diagnostic='JSON root must be an object')
    reject('duplicate-work-item', lambda d: d['backlog']['work_items'].append(copy.deepcopy(d['backlog']['work_items'][0])), diagnostic='not unique')
    reject('dangling-dependency', lambda d: d['backlog']['work_items'][-1]['depends_on'].append('PREP-NOT-REGISTERED'), diagnostic='dangling dependency')
    def cycle(d):
        a, b = d['backlog']['work_items'][:2]
        a['depends_on'], b['depends_on'] = [b['id']], [a['id']]
    reject('dependency-cycle', cycle, diagnostic='cyclic')
    reject('duplicate-graph-node', lambda d: d['knowledge-graph']['nodes'].append(copy.deepcopy(d['knowledge-graph']['nodes'][0])), diagnostic='not unique')
    reject('duplicate-graph-edge', lambda d: d['knowledge-graph']['edges'].append(copy.deepcopy(d['knowledge-graph']['edges'][0])), diagnostic='duplicate')
    reject('dangling-graph-edge', lambda d: d['knowledge-graph']['edges'][0].__setitem__('target', 'NOT-A-NODE'), diagnostic='unknown target')
    reject('a2a-required-edge', lambda d: d['knowledge-graph']['edges'].append(dict(source=d['knowledge-graph']['nodes'][0]['id'], target='concept-a2a', relation='depends_on', source_reference='synthetic audit fixture')), diagnostic='must not')
    reject('unknown-work-status', lambda d: d['backlog']['work_items'][0].__setitem__('status', 'accepted'), diagnostic='invalid status')
    reject('done-without-evidence', lambda d: d['backlog']['work_items'][-1].__setitem__('status', 'done'), diagnostic='done requires')
    for target_status in ('ready','in_progress','done'):
        def incomplete(d, state=target_status):
            item = next(i for i in d['backlog']['work_items'] if i['id'] == 'PREP-007')
            item['status'] = state
            if state == 'done':
                item.update(acceptance_evidence='synthetic fixture only', reproduction_command='synthetic fixture only', independent_reviewer='synthetic reviewer')
            sync_status(d)
        reject('unfinished-dependency-' + target_status, incomplete, diagnostic='requires dependency PREP-006 to be done')
    reject('stale-status-counts-check', lambda d: d['status']['work_item_status_counts'].__setitem__('done', 999), diagnostic='does not match backlog')
    reject('stale-status-counts-render', lambda d: d['status']['work_item_status_counts'].__setitem__('done', 999), 'render', 'does not match backlog')
    reject('product-percent-overclaim', lambda d: d['status'].__setitem__('product_completion_percent', 1), diagnostic='must remain 0')
    reject('bootstrap-overclaim', lambda d: d['status'].__setitem__('bootstrap_status', 'BOOTSTRAP_VERIFIED'), diagnostic='cannot claim')
    reject('conformance-passed-overclaim', lambda d: d['status']['conformance'].__setitem__('passed_tests', 1), diagnostic='must remain 0')

    restore()
    prep7 = next(i for i in baseline['backlog']['work_items'] if i['id'] == 'PREP-007')
